subject: Decision readiness check — Redwood + Sawyer recap
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Han <claire.han@sawyer.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision readiness check — Redwood + Sawyer recap

Hi Claire — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and two asks below.

Recap (30min discovery)
- Primary use case: inference for customer-facing summarization and search at ~300 reqs/s at 8k context.
- Key constraints: data residency (US-only), monthly budget guardrail, SLA target sub-150ms 95th p50 latency for short prompts.
- Current architecture: AWS us-west-2, in-house embedding index, Batch scoring today.

What we recommended
- Redwood Dedicated pool in us-west-2 with prefix caching + hot-model variant for short prompts.
- 2-week pilot (non-prod) to validate latencies + cost profile; typical pilot includes an integration checklist and 1-2 sample inference payloads.

Two asks
1) Quick fit check: does the recommendation map to your needs and constraints? (data residency & SLA callouts are critical).
2) If yes, are you decision-ready this quarter (by Apr 30) or do you need more internal info? If you can, propose a 20-min slot for a technical scoping call — I put a couple options below.

Calendar options (all in PDT)
- Wed Apr 4, 10:30–10:50
- Thu Apr 5, 14:00–14:20
- Mon Apr 9, 09:00–09:20

I've attached a short discovery recap and a one-pager on the pilot scope for the team. Marissa is on Cc if you want a deeper dive into compliance and deployment options.

Thanks — looking forward to your read.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0198
